$comment: Generated by scripts/sync-versions.mjs from the signed Hive release manifests. Edit only notes, upgradeRules and pathRules by hand.

notes.3.0.1: no GitHub release was published for this tag; 3.0.2 followed the same day
notes.3.2.1: publication was blocked by the image gate; 3.2.2 carries its fixes
notes.3.12.8: tagged and signed but never published: the image gate found CVE-2026-121707 in five images; 3.12.9 carries its changes and the fix

upgradeRules.appliesTo: installations with PostgreSQL stores (Magnus, Cindertrace or ChatterMost)
upgradeRules.reason: patched datastore runtime and PostgreSQL collation change
new Emberpath and HiveSkills data formats

upgradeRules.appliesTo: installations whose HiveMem has data owned by hive-router

upgradeRules.reason: Oathweave 2.6.0 data format oathweave-managed-format-2 and HiveSkills hiveskills-managed-format-5; on full installations also Cindertrace, Embermend, Magnus and Ardent Project Studio migrations

pathRules.text: An installation that runs Magnus moves to 3.9.0 or later (Magnus 3, node keys only) from 3.8.1 only, after its nodes have their keys.

Emberpath 2.6.0 declares its data transition from emberpath-managed-format-2 only, so an installation still on emberpath-v1 (a release before 3.4.0) upgrades to a release from 3.4.0 to 3.13.5 first. No earlier release reads the new format, so a code-only rollback from 3.14.0 or later is refused; recover with the verified pre-upgrade backup.
No earlier Oathweave reads oathweave-managed-format-2, so a code-only rollback from 3.15.0 or later to a release before 3.15.0 is refused; recover with the verified pre-upgrade backup.
Code-only rollback across the 3.0.0 PostgreSQL boundary is refused; recovery needs the verified original-state backup.
